channel.title: OpenAI-Selection
channel.description: OpenAI News から選別された記事フィード

item.title: Astraへの道：重要な機能とフロンティアの安全対策(Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards)
item.description: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release.

item.title: 医療機関はEHRおよび追加の業界データをChatGPTに接続できるようになりました(Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and additional industry data to ChatGPT)
item.description: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context, medical research, and more.

item.title: AIへのアクセス拡大におけるマイルストーン(A milestone in expanding access to AI)
item.description: ChatGPT Ads reaches $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate and expands globally, supporting broader access to AI through free and affordable options.

item.title: SpaceXによる買収後のCursorに関する当社の決定(Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX)
item.description: Our decision to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX.

item.title: タイの次世代AIスタートアップを支援(Supporting Thailand’s next generation of AI startups)
item.description: OpenAI and Thailand’s MHESI launch an eight-week accelerator helping 10 health, wellness, and education startups turn AI prototypes into trusted products.

item.title: より良い回答、より広い思考：学生がChatGPTと批判的思考トレーニングから得るもの(Better answers, broader thinking: What students gain from ChatGPT and critical-thinking training)
item.description: A randomized study of more than 1,000 students examines ChatGPT, critical thinking, originality, and student performance on a real-world university assignment.

item.title: OpenAIのブラジルでのプレゼンス拡大(Expanding OpenAI’s presence in Brazil)
item.description: OpenAI is expanding its presence in Brazil, deepening engagement with developers, businesses, and communities to support AI adoption across the country.

item.title: 米国のより多くの学区にChatGPT for Teachersを導入(Bringing ChatGPT for Teachers to more U.S. school districts)
item.description: ChatGPT for Teachers is expanding to 55 U.S. school systems, bringing secure AI tools, training, and support to over 100,000 more educators and staff.

item.title: 学習は止まらない：AIがいかに学習を継続的にするか(Learning never stops: How AI makes learning continuous)
item.description: OpenAI’s new report explores how students and educators use ChatGPT to make learning more continuous, with support that extends beyond the classroom.

item.title: Hugging Faceインシデントと今後の展望(The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead)
item.description: OpenAI shares findings from the Hugging Face security incident and the steps we’re taking to strengthen AI model security, monitoring, and alignment.

item.title: 豊富なインテリジェンスを支えるフルスタック(The full stack behind abundant intelligence)
item.description: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.

item.title: Jalapeñoの最初の結果は、AI推論における業界をリードする速度と効率性を示している(Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference)
item.description: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.

item.title: ロシアからの新たな秘密裏の影響力行使キャンペーンを阻止する(Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia)
item.description: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.

item.title: ChatGPT WorkとCodex向けAdminプラグインの紹介(Introducing the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex)
item.description: Use the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex to analyze workspace usage, manage members and permissions, adjust limits, and act on admin requests.

item.title: フロンティアモデル向けにゼロデータ保持を提供(Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models)
item.description: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

item.title: ChatGPT広告がヨーロッパ全域に拡大(ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe)
item.description: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.

item.title: CodeAIと提携し、最初のAI世代を育成する(Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation)
item.description: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.

item.title: サイバークリティカルな能力の時代におけるモデル開発のペース設定(Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities)
item.description: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.

item.title: ティーン向けChatGPTの紹介：学習のために構築され、保護によって支えられている(Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections)
item.description: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.

item.title: 防御者の窓(The Defender’s Window)
item.description: AI is reshaping cybersecurity for attackers and defenders alike. Learn how OpenAI is strengthening its defenses and what security teams can do now.

item.title: OpenAIがPORTS-Pikeプロジェクトに参加(OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project)
item.description: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project, expanding community investment and supporting thousands of Southern Ohio jobs

item.title: 知能時代に向けた新しい政策アイデア(New policy ideas for the Intelligence Age)
item.description: OpenAI funds 14 independent projects exploring new AI policy ideas to expand economic opportunity and strengthen societal resilience in the Intelligence Age.
